description: Structured query over memories with filters and ordering.

created_after.description: Filter: only memories created at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z)

created_before.description: Filter: only memories created at or before this RFC 3339 timestamp

query.description: Case-insensitive substring filter over content (literal match). For tokenized, ranked full-text retrieval use memory.search

tags.description: Filter: memories with all of these tags

name: memory.query

outputSchema.description: Result envelope for this tool; fields vary by operation.

title: Query memories
